detail.longDescription: While watching GTA VI streams, I - as a non gamer and non game-developer - cannot stop thinking "How this is built?!". So I started and made 4 mini projects called "GTA AT HOME" :D Just for myself to understand how these things work. But I thought it might be cool to share them too. So recorded a video with 4 sections: - Player Status & Interactions - Infusing animations into game play - Streaming a city - Using a Physics engine https:// youtu.be/OfbmKF1pauQ # gta6 # programming # game # godot
